description: Runs the embed-generate Clay v1.5 pipeline as a Tapis Job on TACC Lonestar6, replacing the embed-generate Actor (Abaco) -- see design spec Decision 45. Abaco's worker pool cannot provision for this workload's image size (confirmed: both an ~11.4GB and a ~6.21GB image failed identically); an HPC compute node's disk/memory envelope does not have that ceiling.

schedulerOptions.name: TACC Scheduler Profile
schedulerOptions.description: Scheduler profile for HPC clusters at TACC -- required for apptainer module access, same as nodeodm-ls6.

envVariables.description: The embed-generate invocation payload (visit_id, site_id, zoom, zoom_override, encoder, project_pk, webodm_jwt) -- a JSON string, identical contract to the Abaco Actor's MSG env var (embed_generate/main.py's read_actor_message() is unchanged by this decision; only the delivery mechanism differs). Real value supplied per-job at submission time by apply_embed_generate(), not here.
Real value supplied per-job at submission time (or fixed at registration time if this becomes a static per-deployment constant -- TBD).
Production WebODM host, confirmed reachable from TACC systems the same way ClusterODM/nodeodm-ls6 already reach it (Decision 45, resolved 2026-07-24).

notes.label: embed-generate on LS6
notes.helpText: Runs Clay v1.5 embedding generation for a WebODM task's tiles as a batch job on Lonestar6, replacing the embed-generate Tapis Actor (which cannot provision workers for this image's size).
